BEFORE YOU BUY.

Everything you need to know about your new desi skincare favourite, all in one place.

What makes Lebrostone Multani Mitti Face Pack Soap different?

It brings the goodness of traditional desi skincare ingredients like Multani Mitti, gram flour and rice flour into one convenient cleansing bar. Old-school skincare, meet your everyday routine!

Can I use Multani Mitti Face Pack Soap every day?

Your skincare, your skin’s rules! Follow the directions on the packaging and see how your skin responds. If you notice dryness or irritation, stop using it.

Does Multani Mitti Face Pack Soap help with tanning?

Multani Mitti is a classic in desi skincare routines, but soap alone can’t promise to remove an existing tan. Keep sunscreen in your routine to help protect your skin from further sun damage.

Is Lebrostone Multani Mitti Face Pack Soap suitable for all skin types?

Every skin has its own vibe! Check the full ingredient list before use, especially if you have sensitive or dry skin. A patch test is always a smart first step.

What’s actually inside this soap?

Desi skincare classics, all in one bar! The highlighted ingredients include Multani Mitti, gram flour, rice flour and coconut oil. Check the packaging for the full ingredient list.
